name: Bakersfield
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The first-party City of Bakersfield GIS Cadastre service publishes parcel polygons; Kern County Assessor-Recorder separately documents parcel mapping GIS. Exact WUP-point query returned one polygon with safe Esri OBJECTID only.
scopeLimits: 119 distinct native APN references passed thirteen 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Bakersfield WUP locator, complete native-projected bounds manifests and all fresh exact native identity reads. A separate 1 km metric-square envelope supplied 761 full source polygons; an independent root EPSG:32611 GEOS audit found all valid and distinct, with no overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. APN_ID strings are preserved independently of OBJECTID transport keys; APN 14734302 maps to OBJECTID 127663 and contains the locator. Forced three-feature paging, explicit absence, full footprint and source binding passed. Native EPSG:2229 bounds projection resolves the previously inconsistent WGS84 count/manifests without changing geometry. Earlier failed probes are retained in the acceptance record. This bounded evidence does not establish citywide completeness, legal title, accuracy or currentness.

queries.query: Bakersfield Kern County official parcel map GIS cadastral layer
queries.scope: Identify first-party city-bound registry custody and safely accessible public parcel geometry.
queries.result: The city’s first-party ArcGIS layer metadata identifies a public Polygon Parcels feature layer and safe OID.
